story.title: Meta opened a new AI lane for developers

instagramCaption:
Meta opened a new AI lane for developers

Meta released Muse Spark 1.1 and opened developer access through the Meta Model API.

Why it matters: AI is moving from chat into tools that can help people build, test, and finish real work.

Una Labs take: The bigger signal is simple: the AI race is becoming a workflow race. A powerful model is useful, but a model people can actually build with is more important.

Would you use this now, or wait until the tools mature?

Source: Meta AI Blog - https://ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-meta-model-api/

linkedInCaption:
Meta opened a new AI lane for developers

Meta released Muse Spark 1.1 and opened developer access through the Meta Model API.

The practical point is this: AI news only matters if it changes how people build, work, learn, support customers, or make decisions.

AI is moving from chat into tools that can help people build, test, and finish real work.

Una Labs take: The bigger signal is simple: the AI race is becoming a workflow race. A powerful model is useful, but a model people can actually build with is more important.

For builders and small teams, the next step is not to chase every launch. The next step is to pick one workflow, test it carefully, keep proof, and decide if it actually saves time or improves quality.

What would you test first?

Source: Meta AI Blog - https://ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-meta-model-api/
